title: Certify a 343-bit coupled residue domain for P104 lifting
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3033 scalar split:  1,024 residue bits per 128 Gaussian components
Coupled prefix lattice: 343 residue bits, all real coordinates still <16
N=512 four-block map:  4,096 -> 1,372 residue bits
```

Close a bounded part of PR3033 open question 2. Prove signed-input equivariance for a coupled translation lattice, certify its exact rank-seven index and triangular basis, and implement the identical lifting map with canonical residues. The inverse uses the image lattice UΓ; a regression example shows why reusing Γ can fail.

This reduces the local nonlinear domain by 66.5%. It establishes no runtime gain, admitted supplier or new κ. Decomposition, an extra narrow linear pass, intermediate widths, buffers, physical restoration and the complete caller/backend bill remain charged or unresolved. Stop after this local result; no dependent construction expansion or selected-frontier change.

Only `research/p104-coupled-lifting-residues/` is added. Base main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6; PR3033 dependency `b12bbaeb5ca2e83f15433fc2dd0ba3b766595281`. Both were refreshed and unchanged before submission. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18981569).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3033 retains 1,024 independent residue bits per block. **After:** exact prefix-kernel intersections give index 2^343; a separate simultaneous-congruence modular implementation agrees for ranks 1–7. HNF membership plus equal determinant certifies the complete stated prefix lattice, without a Sympy replay dependency.
- All 256 basis columns pass forward/inverse translation comparisons against byte-identical predecessor code. Eighteen signed fixtures through 4,090 bits, ±4,096-bit boundary controls, two synthetic wrapped N=512 fixtures and 162 signed pair cases pass. Eight behavioral groups include unpruned rank-one/two quotient oracles, same-index invalid basis, source/typed-receipt corruption and read-only Git-free optimized exports.
- Normal and optimized registered replay, warnings-as-errors compilation, Ruff and byte-identical optional Sympy regeneration pass locally on macOS arm64/CPython 3.12.15. Two scoped internal reviews found one shared signed-intermediate headroom issue, now fixed and rechecked. All 15 publication files match commit `0cc430349a3f3dc200666bc22e997076e0a557ed`. Hosted CI and independent human/formal review remain separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-coupled-lifting-residues
```

Credit Tekalign/PR3025/3033 for the floor word, collector, scalar split and backend boundary; ywz65/PR2586, Arham Tahir/PR2999 and the retained P104 geometry/native lineage. Substantial automated assistance is disclosed in the package. General lattice parity kernels and Hermite normal form are not claimed as new.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

One additive opt-in research package. No shared checker, frozen predecessor, selected record, priority or other PR disposition changes.
